registerStatus: Historical Phase 4 snapshot; superseded as the canonical register by docs/phase-5/RELEASE_GATE_REGISTER.json

gates.description: The real Phase 3 source must be available, identified by immutable commit, audited, and safely integrated before overlapping Phase 4 work.
gates.owner: Phase 4 integration owner; independent reviewer unassigned
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Phase 3 source ref and head are recorded; comparison with Phase 2 is reviewed; migrations and ownership controls are audited; a normal reviewed integration preserves both branches; conflicts and merge evidence are recorded.
gates.remainingWork: Obtain independent review of the integration record and Phase 4 access-control fixes; do not confuse this gate with production approval.
gates.productionImpact: No longer blocks local hardening; other open gates block pilot and production.

gates.description: Controlled dataset must have resolving provenance, exact canonical parity, and approved current verification.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Immutable controlled revision passes reconciliation and all production service/council records receive current primary-source human verification and approval.
gates.remainingWork: Reverify all operational records before pilot and publish any approved changes through a new controlled revision.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks publication of unverified or unresolved critical records.

gates.description: Production infrastructure, migrations, backup, restore, monitoring, and rollback must be proven in isolated target environments.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Target-environment migrations, environment isolation, current backup, successful restore, alert tests, release guard, RTO/RPO, and rollback are evidenced and reviewed.
gates.remainingWork: Provision isolated hosted environments and complete provider-native backup/PITR, restore, monitoring, and rollback exercises after Phase 3 integration.

gates.description: Authentication, encryption, session, account lifecycle, and privileged access require complete implementation and adversarial review.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved identity and email providers, secrets/key operation, recovery, deletion, complete ownership enforcement, privileged access controls, and adversarial tests pass.
gates.remainingWork: Audit Phase 3 authentication and roles; complete providers, key management, lifecycle jobs, and security tests.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks persistent private UI, privileged roles, pilot, and production.

gates.description: All integrated journeys require WCAG 2.2 AA automated and manual verification plus lived-experience testing.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Required keyboard, zoom/reflow, contrast, screen-reader/browser/device, voice-control, upload, print, and lived-experience tests are documented, defects retested, and an authorised reviewer approves the result.
gates.remainingWork: Repeat the full audit after Phase 3 integration and conduct required human/device testing.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks pilot expansion and public production.

gates.description: Privacy, legal, editorial, safeguarding, data-sharing, complaints, and AI governance require authorised human approval.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Required governance documents are complete, internally consistent, versioned, and signed by authorised accountable owners.
gates.remainingWork: Update for the actual Phase 3 data flows and obtain all named approvals.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks processing of production personal data and public release.

gates.description: Casework, timelines, deadlines, suitability, complaints, and reviews must preserve ownership and fail safely.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Actual Phase 3 case domains are inventoried and pass migration, ownership, cross-user denial, accessibility, retention, and full-journey tests.
gates.remainingWork: Complete full route-level adversarial, accessibility, retention, concurrency, and 20-journey review; obtain independent review.

gates.description: Evidence upload, storage, scanning, access, download, retention, and deletion must be private and verified.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Private storage, encryption, validation, scanning, short-lived access, per-request authorisation, logging, lifecycle, deletion, backup, restore, and adversarial tests pass.
gates.remainingWork: Phase 3 metadata-only controls are audited; implement and verify an approved private object-storage, scanning, redaction, download, lifecycle, backup, and deletion system.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks evidence upload and production storage.

gates.description: Consent, advocate access, professional access, sharing, expiry, and revocation must be granular and enforced on every action.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Case assignment and recipient-specific consent are enforced; expiry/revocation is immediate; no unassigned access or impersonation exists; permission history and negative tests pass.
gates.remainingWork: Obtain independent access-control review and complete the professional-helper operational design; external sharing remains subject to MAIL-001 and governance approval.
gates.productionImpact: Automated technical acceptance is complete; independent, governance, and external-integration gates still block production sharing.

gates.description: External email requires approved provider integration, explicit user approval, recipient/attachment safety, idempotency, and audit.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Minimum scopes, preview and approval, safe-contact checks, correct recipients and attachments, receipts, idempotency, retries, cancellation, revocation, failure tests, and human approval pass.
gates.remainingWork: Keep external sending disabled; audit any Phase 3 integration and provision an approved sandbox/provider.

gates.description: Generated documents and exports must be private, accurate, accessible, versioned, and injection resistant.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Correct ownership, consent, fields, evidence and versions; no hidden data or cross-case cache; accessible/searchable output; injection, concurrency, filename, and temporary-file tests pass.
gates.remainingWork: Await and audit the real Phase 3 document/export implementation, then complete privacy and accessibility testing.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks generated PDF and case-pack release.

gates.description: Safeguarding processes require clear system boundaries and named, trained human operational ownership.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Lead, deputy, out-of-hours, child/adult/domestic-abuse/trafficking/suicide/immediate-danger processes, training, supervision, retention, and escalation boundaries are approved and exercised.
gates.remainingWork: Audit Phase 3 controls, appoint owners, approve procedures, train staff, and run exercises. AI must never independently refer.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks safeguarding workflows, pilot, and production.

gates.description: Retention, expiry, revocation, deletion, search removal, object removal, audit limits, and backup expiry must be enforceable and verified.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Approved schedule and jobs pass synthetic end-to-end tests across sessions, drafts, cases, evidence, consent, accounts, indexes, logs, storage, and backups, including exceptions.
gates.remainingWork: Audit Phase 3 jobs, approve periods, implement any gaps, and verify deletion including governed backup expiry.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks production personal-data retention and deletion claims.

gates.description: An independent penetration test must cover the integrated staging system and its roles, APIs, storage, exports, and integrations.
gates.acceptanceCriteria: Scope and synthetic accounts are approved; independent testing is complete; all critical/high findings are fixed and retested or specifically accepted by an authorised risk owner.
gates.remainingWork: Prepare integrated staging scope and synthetic accounts, engage an independent tester, and remediate findings.
gates.productionImpact: Blocks public production while critical/high findings are unresolved or testing is unscheduled.
